The Turb 555 / Turb 555 IR lets you perform turbidity measurements easily 
 and reliably.

The measuring method used in the Turb 555 IR corresponds to the ISO 7027 /
 DIN 27027.
 The measuring method used in the Turb 555 follows the US EPA
 construction recommendation.

The 
 Turb 555 /Turb 555 IR can measure with different measuring methods. To do 
 so, the measuring signals of the four detectors are evaluated differently.

The 
 specified measuring unit determines whether a 90 scattered light 
 measurement or a transmission measurement is performed.

NTU = Nephelometric Turbidity Units (90scattered light measurement).
